children: Beta Bionics reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $35.5M, up 30% from $27.3M a year earlier, while its net loss widened to $24.4M from $14.2M. Diluted loss per share was $(0.52), compared with $(0.33) in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $35.5M, compared with $27.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 30%.
Net loss was $24.4M, compared with $14.2M in the prior-year quarter; the loss widened by $10.1M, or 71%.
Diluted EPS was $(0.52), compared with $(0.33) in the prior-year quarter.
Nine-month net sales rose 40% to $95.1M, driven by growth in iLet users and recurring single-use product sales.
Pharmacy-benefit sales accounted for 38% of nine-month net sales, up from 21% a year earlier. Management expects the channel to improve iLet lifetime economics.
About 69% of nine-month 2026 adoption came from people previously using injections.
The FDA cleared the Mint patch pump in September 2026. Beta Bionics plans a U.S. commercial launch in the first quarter of 2027 and is targeting capacity of 1.5 million disposable units that year.
Enrollment in the pivotal type 2 diabetes trial was completed in October 2026. The company is targeting a mid-2027 indication expansion, subject to FDA clearance.
